description: This file defines an interface class 'GatekeeperChannel' for communication channels that handle synchronous Gatekeeper IPC/RPC calls within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes method declarations for sending requests and responses, and receiving messages, and references external message and channel classes.

classes.name: GatekeeperChannel
classes.description: An interface class for communication channels that handle Gatekeeper IPC/RPC calls synchronously.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message with a command identifier and a GateKeeperMessage.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message with a command identifier and a GateKeeperMessage.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives a message from the channel, returning a ManagedMessage.
